result:
Done.

**Root cause:** `clrCastleSq` in `variants/bug05/movegen.inc` mapped square a1 to the white *kingside* rights bit (`and 0xFE`, bit0) instead of the queenside one (`and 0xFD`, bit1) — one wrong mask byte, from which all four reported symptoms follow, because a stale WQ bit makes `genCastling` emit O-O-O with no rook on a1 and the legal-move filter's make/unmake (`mkOOOw`/`umOOO`) then *writes* a rook onto a1.

**Files touched**
- `variants/bug05/movegen.inc` — the fix (1 code byte) + a contract comment on `clrCastleSq` and one comment per corner
- `variants/bug05/test_castle_rights.py` — new, 15-case harness regression test
- `variants/bug05/Makefile` — `test` target runs it
- `variants/bug05/chess.bin`, `chess.tap` — rebuilt
- `FIX_NOTES.md`, `STATE.md` — workspace root

The rebuilt `chess.bin` differs from the pre-fix build in **exactly one byte** (offset 4426, `0xFE`→`0xFD`); code length unchanged at 13516 bytes, so nothing shifted.

**Gates**
| gate | result |
|---|---|
| Repro 1 (phantom rook) | **pass** — `8/4k3/8/8/8/8/R7/4K3 w - - 2 2`, material 500 |
| Repro 2 (O-O-O must be refused) | **pass** — refused, log stops at `a1a2 e8e7` |
| Repro 3 (O-O must be accepted) | **pass** — rank 1 = `5RK1` |
| Both report controls | **pass** — unchanged |
| `make test` (6 checks) | **pass** |
| New test | **pass** — 15/15; and 5/15 red on the pre-fix tape, exactly the a1 cases |
| Built-in `T` self-test | **pass** — `PERFT OK`, Kiwipete d3 = 97862 (was 97739 BAD) |
| Characterisation (57 cases) | **57/57, exit 0** — was 54/57; nothing re-recorded |
| Review round | **round 1 clean — "No defect in the fix."** Gate closed, 1 of 3 rounds |

The characterisation result is the independent check: its baseline came from the *pristine* build, and its `mv_rights_lost` case expected `castling 9` (`Kq`) where the buggy build gave `10` (`Qq`).

**Knowingly left open** (recorded in `FIX_NOTES.md`, not required to resolve)
- `genCastling` still trusts the rights bit without checking a rook is on the corner, so an *injected* inconsistent position can still conjure a rook. Pre-existing and byte-identical in the pristine build, unreachable from legal play, and left alone deliberately — a guard would change code length, which `characterisation/README.md` §4.12 flags as a hazard for the pinned Zobrist/TT behaviour.
- `Makefile:18` `SRC` omits `perft.inc`/`zobrist.inc`/`tt.inc` — pre-existing, unrelated.
- The three black-corner test cases I added *after* the review were verified by execution only, not by the reviewer.
